# Keith Billings

> Keith Billings is a web developer based in Oregon with over 5 years of experience, specializing in React and front-end development. He led the custom web development team at Brandlive, building custom virtual events, components, and integrations for Fortune 100 brands.

This site is a single-page React app, so its pages render client-side. This file summarizes the same content in plain text.

## About

- Front-end specialist who builds modern websites, utilitarian web tools, and API and data integrations
- Attended the University of Oregon Coding Bootcamp (full stack web development certificate, MERN stack) and the University of London - Goldsmiths (pursuing a BSc in Computer Science)
- Skills: React, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS/SCSS, Node.js, Next.js, Figma, Git/GitHub, Jira, MongoDB, Python
- Background before tech includes construction and building maintenance, customer service, bartending, and firefighting

## Experience

- Lead Custom Web Developer at Brandlive (March 2021 - September 2026): led the custom web development team; built new features, custom components, and custom virtual events; handled accessibility compliance; set up analytics (GA4, GTM, LinkedIn, Facebook, Adobe) and CRM integrations (Salesforce, Marketo, Adobe) with Tray.ai; built a custom DOM manipulation JavaScript library; maintained the company website in Framer with a focus on accessibility and SEO
- Brands worked with include AARP, Adidas, Asana, Block, Clarivate, ClickUp, Columbia, Dow Jones, Google, Hyundai, Nike, Nintendo, The North Face, NPR, Pink, Pluralsight, Public, Sony, Vans, Wired, and YouTube
